artworks.title: Two Women in Profile
artworks.description: The image features two full-length figures facing each other. On the left, a person with an elegant hairstyle and a feathered hat stands in a flowing gown. On the right, another individual wears a textured brimmed hat and a long coat while holding a cane. The background is simple with no distractions, and the scene is bordered by a thin frame.

artworks.title: Lady in a Large Coat
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 6 × 8.8 cm (2 3/8 × 3 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-length figures facing slightly to the side so their profiles are visible. Each person is positioned to one side of the image, looking towards the viewer with a subtle turn of the head. Both figures have distinct facial features with relatively serious expressions and short, neat hair peeking out from beneath wide-brimmed hats. They are donned in long, flowing garments consisting of layered cloaks that create a sense of movement and depth. The clothing details on the right figure are more intricately depicted with fine lines representing the texture and folds of the fabric, particularly on the skirt portion, whereas the left figure's clothing is more simplified. No specific jewelry or objects are visible on either figure. The background is plain and unadorned, with a lightly textured surface suggesting a simple wall or backdrop without particular detail.

artworks.title: Lady in a Large Coat
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length drawings of a person positioned in profile, both facing right. The person in the drawing on the left has short hair partially covered by a hat with a brim. They wear a long, loose-fitting garment with a cloak draped over their shoulders and arms. The drawing on the right mirrors this pose and attire closely. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Front View
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body drawings of the same person in different poses. On the left, the person stands in a relaxed manner, turned slightly to the side, with one arm bent and the other resting on the hilt of a sword. On the right, the person has a more pronounced lean back, both hands resting on the hilt of the sword. The person has angular facial features, curly hair peeking out from underneath a wide-brimmed hat with a tall feather, and is dressed in historically detailed clothing including a long cloak, voluminous breeches, and decorated shoes. They have a sword with a distinctive hilt around their waist. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Front with Hand on Hip
artworks.description: The etching depicts two standing figures in similar poses. Both figures show a person with one hand on their hip and the other holding a sword or stick. The facial features are basic, with a simple expression. The figure wears a large hat with feathers and draped clothing resembling a classical style, including a cloak or toga-like garment and loose-fitting pants. The feet are turned slightly outward. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures.

artworks.title: Gentleman in Large Mantle, Seen from Behind
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures wearing cloaks and hats, viewed from the back. The drawing features two outlined figures standing beside each other, each dressed in a flowing cape that reaches down to their thighs, and adorned with decorative bows tied around their legs. They appear to be holding walking sticks or canes. The hats perched upon their heads are round and wide-brimmed, with decorative elements embellishing them. The figure on the left exhibits more intricate linework, suggesting shadows and folds within the cloak, while the right figure is drawn with more minimal lines. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Peasant with a Cup
artworks.description: The image depicts two full-body drawings of a person from behind and in profile. Both figures are standing facing slightly to the right, with one holding a long object resembling a staff or walking stick in their left hand and a tankard in the right hand. The facial features are not visible. The person wears a wide-brimmed hat, a long coat belted at the waist, knee-length trousers or leggings, and shoes with visible soles. The left figure's coat has vertical lines suggesting a textured fabric. The figures are set against a plain background.

artworks.title: Gentleman Viewed from the Side
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body illustrations of the same standing person, posed in a three-quarters turn facing the right side. The person has distinct facial features, curly hair, and wears a hat with feathers. They are adorned with a fur-trimmed cape, knee-length breeches, stockings, and shoes with bows. A sword is visible under the cape. There are no visible jewelry pieces. The illustrations are set against a plain, textured background.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 5.5 × 8.1 cm (2 3/16 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two individuals engaging in a duel. The figures are dressed in historic attire and are poised in a dynamic stance as they engage in combat with swords drawn. Both figures have one foot forward, indicating their readiness to advance or parry. They are attired in period clothing, with detailed hats and puffed sleeves, emphasizing the historical context. The figures are positioned on a textured ground, adding depth to the background. This style of illustration is reminiscent of early modern etchings, capturing the energetic movement and tension of a duel in a singular snapshot.

artworks.title: Duel with Swords and Daggers
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in sword fighting. The image depicts two individuals in dynamic poses, each holding a sword in one hand. One figure leans slightly backward, while the other leans forward aggressively. Both figures are dressed in flowing garments and the background is minimalistic. The lines are finely detailed, capturing movement and tension in the confrontation.

artworks.title: Peasant with Shovel on His Shoulder
artworks.description: The image shows a side view perspective of a lone figure on the right side. The horizon is low in the image, above the bottom edge, with a faint outline of a landscape. The landscape has soft, undulating lines suggesting foliage or structures. The figure wears period attire with a hat, loose clothes, holds a walking stick, and rests a tool on his shoulder. The drawing technique is precise with sharp lines, reminiscent of engraving or etching. The color palette is monochromatic, with primarily off-white and black ink defining the elements. The simple style emphasizes the figure and the surrounding space.

artworks.title: Peasant Attacked by Bees
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man standing in a landscape with a small dog and some trees. The image shows a man in historical clothing, holding a walking stick at his side while the other hand reaches out towards a group of bees. The dog at his feet appears to be jumping or standing on its hind legs, seemingly intrigued by the bees as well. In the background, there is a pastoral landscape with a few scattered trees, a winding path, distant hills, and a small structure that resembles a cabin or barn. The drawing is monochrome, emphasizing the line work and subtle details in the illustration.

artworks.title: Peasant with Sack
artworks.description: The image shows an older man standing upright, facing to the right. He has detailed facial features with a stern expression, wearing a wide-brimmed hat that partially covers his hair. He is dressed in a long robe with layers underneath, and light footwear. He holds a walking stick in one hand and a folded piece of cloth in the other. The background includes a tree trunk on the right, sparse vegetation, a rocky terrain on the left, and possibly a goat under a cliff edge. The scene is set outdoors in a rural area.

artworks.title: Peasant Removing His Shoe
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a man resting against a tree and a donkey standing nearby. Buildings and vegetation can be seen in the distance below the low horizon. The artwork features a monochrome color palette and intricate line work, creating contrast between the foreground and background.

artworks.title: Peasant Defecating
artworks.description: The image is an ink drawing showing a person crouching to the left. The person's face is partially obscured by a hat, and they are wearing a cloak or coat. The person holds an object behind their back. Trees are in the background, along with an unidentifiable object on the right. The background is a minimal landscape with undefined texture and lines, creating a sense of openness.

artworks.title: Shepherd Playing Flute
artworks.description: The image shows a shepherd standing under a tree, watching over his flock with his dog beside him. The sheep are grazing peacefully nearby, with a simple horizon and sky in the background. In the distance, a faint architectural structure is visible on a hill. The etching features precise line work and a monochromatic color palette, emphasizing light and shadow to convey detail and mood.

artworks.title: Dancers with Flute and Tambourine
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two entertainers playing musical instruments. The drawing shows two figures engaged in musical performance, each playing a different instrument. The figure on the left is playing a small drum, held up high, while the figure on the right is playing a flute or similar wind instrument. Both figures are wearing elaborately detailed clothing, with voluminous sleeves and textured leggings. Their postures suggest movement and rhythm. The drawing is rendered in fine, precise lines that capture the fabric’s texture and the figures’ dynamic poses.

artworks.title: Dancers with Lute
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two fantastical creatures. One is playing a stringed instrument while the other appears to be listening or dancing. The creatures have exaggerated facial characteristics and are dressed in voluminous, patterned garments with intricate line work. The figure on the left raises one foot and seems engaged with the other figure. The figure on the right holds a stringed instrument. Their costumes and expressions are whimsical. The background is minimal.

artworks.title: Two Pantaloons Dancing
artworks.description: The image shows two figures with elongated, curved lines and exaggerated anatomical features. The figures appear to be engaged in a dynamic dance, with their limbs extending and twisting in exaggerated poses. The texture and form resemble twisted trees or limbs bending under their own weight, while their postures convey a sense of rhythm and motion. The shapes hint at human-like forms blended with fantastical elements, such as enlarged joints and undulating lines.

artworks.title: Two Pantaloons Dancing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mythical creatures facing each other. The creatures exhibit exaggerated, distorted human-like anatomy. The one on the left is in a dynamic pose with one arm bent and the other reaching slightly forward. The creature on the right holds a relaxed posture and appears to lean on a staff or sword propped against its back. Both figures have prominent facial features including large eyes and extended tongues. The use of fine lines and shading creates texture and depth in the creatures' bodies against a plain background.

artworks.title: Almshouse
artworks.description: The image shows a building with a triangular pediment and multiple arches in its design. There are people scattered throughout the scene. The vantage point is slightly elevated, capturing the architecture and the people. The horizon is not visible, framed by structures and figures with the building at the center. Figures are positioned close and far engaged in different activities. The etching style shows fine lines with detailed clothing and architecture. The color palette is monochrome with primarily blacks and whites, emphasizing contrast and detailed line work. On the right, there is a large figure seated with a draped garment, possibly guiding towards the building or the people.

artworks.title: Tavern
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic village scene with a group of figures interacting around a table. The ink drawing displays a group of figures in what appears to be a village square, with a large tree as the central element on the left side of the composition. Several buildings, structured with arches and a pointed roof adorned with a crescent-shaped ornament, serve as the backdrop to the scene. To the right, a small group of figures is actively participating in an activity involving a large rectangular table at the center. The intricate lines and shading techniques create a sense of texture, particularly noticeable in the clothing of the figures and the leaves of the tree. The drawing captures a moment of communal interaction in a rural setting.

artworks.title: Military Commander on Foot
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure in a historical costume directing a scene of action. The illustration shows a figure in an elaborate outfit, complete with a plumed hat and stylish attire typical of a past era. The figure is pointing a slender object towards a direction to the left. Unidentified forms and lines are present in the background, while there are silhouettes of buildings or a city further in. The sky contains swirling patterns. The drawing captures a sense of drama and historical significance through detailed line work.

artworks.title: Military Commander on Horseback
artworks.description: The drawing features a mounted figure leading an army. The central figure rides a rearing horse, with the horse adorned ornately. The background shows a vast landscape with smaller figures that seem to be troops. Rustic structures are visible on the distant horizon. The drawing style is delicate with fine lines.
